cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

mechanism: A transfers an awkward cashbox handover to its trained helper by treating new objections as signs of readiness for independent responsibility.
confusable: Not generic delegation: A converts the pupil caution and next-step awareness into grounds for taking over the burden.
comparison: Custody and face-to-face explanation versus remote receipt chasing.
seedUse: D125 cashbox/broken lock/home/count/key; S05 granting pupil responsibility.
